notes.title: Finally released on June 27th!!
notes.content:
[p]Dear players, thank you for waiting!
We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]full version of  journey of reincarnation will officially launch on June 27, 2025 (JST), at exactly midnight (12:00 AM).[/b][/p][p]Please note that this release will include the [b]Japanese version only.[/b]
An [b]English version is planned for release at a later date[/b], following the launch. We appreciate your understanding and patience.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎵 Also launching at the same time:
[b]The Original Soundtrack for [i]Reincarnation Journey[/i]![/b]
A [b]special bundle[/b] including the game and the soundtrack will be available as well—don’t miss it![/p][hr][/hr][p]It’s been about a year since development began,
and we couldn’t have made it this far without the incredible support and encouragement from so many of you.[/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts—[b]thank you.[/b][/p][p]We've poured that gratitude and passion into the game,
shaping it into a full experience we hope you'll enjoy.
While we’re still growing as developers and there may be imperfections,
we truly hope you’ll give it a try.[/p][hr][/hr][p]If you do play the game,
even a brief [b]review or comment[/b] would mean the world to us.
Your feedback will help us improve and inspire future projects.[/p][p]Should you find any bugs, typos, or other issues,
please let us know via the [b]store’s discussion board[/b].
Your help will allow us to respond quickly and make prompt fixes.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We sincerely hope your “journey” in this game is a meaningful and unforgettable one.[/p][p][b]MSBgamedev
- Masabokuri -[/b][/p]

notes.title: Japanese and English DEMO common update [2024.12.7]
notes.content:
Around 13:00 on December 7th, Japan time
We have updated the Japanese and English demo versions.

If you downloaded and played the game before this,
we apologize for the inconvenience, but please update from the store.

In addition, if you continue playing from a backup save in the dungeon after this update,
we recommend starting a new game, as there is a risk that the game will not load properly.


[Patch contents]

- The prologue BGM has been updated with a new song, "Unpath" by composer Aomo Akane.


- Some lines that do not need to be repeated during the replay have been modified so that they are cut after being displayed once.


- Fixed so that items obtained when defeating the secret boss can be carried over between replays.


- Lines for characters that can be recruited that were not translated into English have now been translated, so a patch has been applied so that they will be displayed in English.


That's all.


In addition, as of this patch, the English translation of the demo version is about 90% complete.
We're almost done with all the translations.

To all the players who are waiting for the English translation to be completed,
we're almost there, so we'll do our best!

And it looks like we'll reach 2,000 wishlist subscribers.

We owe this all to your continued support.
Thank you so much!

We're continuing to work hard towards the release of the final version,
so we'd appreciate your continued support.



MSBgamedev: Masabokuri

notes.title: English and Japanese DEMO common update
notes.content:
At around 14:00 on November 14, 2024, Japan time
An update patch was applied to the Japanese and English demo versions.
If you downloaded and played the game before this,
please update from the store.

In addition, restarting from within a dungeon using the backup autosave
may not start the game properly.
We recommend that you start a new game.

[Patch fixes]

- Events where you encounter characters that can be recruited have been limited to the 1st floor.

Until the previous build, the characters that could be encountered 
in the dungeon appeared separately on the 1st and 2nd floors.

Because of this, if you were unable to encounter the desired companion on the 1st floor
you had to go to the 2nd floor with fewer members.

In addition, if you had a full team on the 1st floor,

even if a character you wanted to recruit appeared on the 2nd floor,

you could not discharge the character and have them join.

With this specification, we felt that it was more stressful for players because they couldn't create the build they wanted than it was intended to create the dilemma we were looking for in production, so we changed the specification and now the characters that can be recruited will only appear on the 1st floor.

This change in specification does not change the variety of characters that can be recruited.
However, we have balanced the appearance rate so that the characters do not overlap with the starting members as much as possible.


We will continue to take player feedback into consideration and work hard to create an easier-to-play experience, so we would appreciate your support.


MSBgamedev: Masabokuri

notes.content:
November 2, 2024, Japan time
We have updated the localization of the English version of the demo.

We are also currently working on localizing the in-game event text.

Please wait a little longer.

If you downloaded and played the game before this update,

notes.title: Tutorial update for Japanese DEMO version
notes.content:
Around 13:00 on October 7, 2024, Japan time
The tutorial for the Japanese demo version has been updated.

If you have downloaded and played the game before this date,
please update it from the store and play it.

In addition, the autosave data for dungeon data downloaded 
before this date may not be loaded properly,

so we recommend that you select New Game.



As for the changes to the tutorial,

in the previous version, the fonts were not unified and
the design was visually difficult to see,
so we unified the design and divided up the information 
that was too crowded on one page to make it easier to understand.

In addition, we have improved the text to be easier to
 read by using a font that can use kanji only for the tutorial
(We have intentionally limited the use of kanji in the main game)
so that the atmosphere of the game is not spoiled as much as possible.

We have also prepared help text for when you get stuck 
on the strategy in the tutorial, so if you are not good at roguelikes,


if you want to enjoy only the story, or
if you want to enjoy customizing it yourself,
please take a look at it.


If you find any typos or misprints, please post on the forum and we will correct them.

With this, the Japanese DEMO version is now [version 3.0.0], and is almost complete as a trial version.


Going forward, we will complete the English DEMO to the same level,
 and once that is complete, we will start working on the main game.


We are also simultaneously working on the original soundtrack, 
and aiming for its release, so we hope you will look forward to that as well.


MSBgamedev: Masabokuri

notes.title: English localization patch and faster battles
notes.content:
Around noon on September 22, 2024, Japan time

The work to translate the 
"character skill names" and "consumable item names" 
of the English demo data into English has been completed, 
so we have applied the patch data.

As a result, the English demo version is now [Version 1.1.6].

If you downloaded and played the game before this, 
we apologize for the inconvenience, but please update from the store.

Also, autosave data in dungeons before this may not load properly, 
so we recommend starting a new game.

In addition, a patch that increases the 
speed of the double speed function during battles from 2 to 3 times 
has been applied as a common patch for both the English and Japanese versions.

*The Japanese version is now [Version 2.1.4].

This has further accelerated the battle speed and improved the game tempo.

There is no change in the normal speed animation speed.


The next update is scheduled to be an English localization 
update of the equipment names of the English demo.


MSBgamedev: Masabokuri

(There are no corrections to the Japanese version,

From this point on, we will continue to apply partial English localization patches.

Next time, we plan to apply a patch for the player character's skill names,

We apologize for the inconvenience,

notes.title: EN/JP DEMO version Common Patches.
notes.content:
At around 12:00 AM on September 2, 2024, 
Japan time, a patch was applied to both the EN and JP demo versions.

If you downloaded and are playing the game before this, please update from the store.


Fixes

- Fixed a bug where the trigger event would keep looping if you had
　 conquered and repeated the troll battle event, making it impossible to enter the battle.

In addition, we also patched the EN version at the same time as we made
 progress in localizing some of the help text that had not been translated.


In the future, we will continue to work on the EN version localization,

 we have made a significant amount of progress.

We apologize for the inconvenience this will cause to those
playing the EN version for a while, and we appreciate your understanding.


MSBgamedev: Masabokuri

notes.title: Japanese ＤＥＭＯ Version Update August 8 【Version 2.1.0】
notes.content:
The Japanese DEMO version was updated around midnight on August 8th, Japan time.
This brings the version to [2.1.0].

If you downloaded the game prior to this,
please upload it from the store page.

Also, backup saves that were autosaved prior to this may not function properly.
In that case, we apologize for the inconvenience, but
we ask that you start a new game.


In this update, we made some balance adjustments to 
improve the previously mentioned issues of
 [total wipeout on the first floor] and [unfriendliness of combat].

Although it is a roguelike game,
the developer did not want to create a so-called death game, 
but rather made adjustments to provide a game that even light users could enjoy.


I would like to announce the changes.



- Elite monsters have been removed from the first floor of the dungeon
  and the number of regular monsters has been increased.

This will reduce the chance of being wiped out on the first floor, 
and we've adjusted the monster balance to make it easier to get used to the battle.



-Increased the encounter rate of the shop on the 1st floor.

We had set the encounter rate of the shop on the 1st floor high,
but even so, there were patterns in which it did not appear,
and in these cases,

[the difficulty level would increase significantly]

There was a possibility that there would be an oversupply,
so we made adjustments so that you can encounter at least one as much as possible.



- The gatekeeper on the second floor has been changed to a new monster.

As a result, the gatekeepers on the first, second, and third floors will all be different monsters,
and we've adjusted the difficulty to gradually increase.


-Because the elite monsters on the first floor have been removed, it has become harder to obtain
  [Level Up Gems], but the 50 points
  you could obtain by defeating an elite have been increased to 100 points.


From the second floor onwards, elite monsters will appear, 
just like in the previous version. We've made adjustments so 
that the total amount of expected level-up points you can gain will not change.


- When selecting a character at the beginning of reincarnation, [Party Type] is now displayed.


Up until now, you could only judge a character's appearance and gameplay, 
but now we have made changes to make it easier to determine their 

[Combat Type] by displaying three types: 
[Strength Type], [Defense Type],  [Unique Type].


- Subdivision of volume adjustment options

Until now, volume adjustments could only be made in increments of 20%, 
but we've now adjusted it so that it can be changed in increments of 5% for finer adjustments.

We've also set a Master Volume so that the overall volume can be adjusted in-game.

As a result, we've removed the BGS (ambient sound) adjustment, which is no longer used.



-Full-screen mode implementation

Until now, the basic resolution was only 816 pixels wide x 612 pixels high
and the only way to change the screen size was by clicking on the window.

We have added [Full-screen mode] to the options

so that the game will start in full screen mode from the next time you start it.
(You will need to quit the game once after setting this up)



- Monsters on each floor used to follow the character, but now they can move freely around the room.

Until now, they would not leave the room, but they would follow the character loosely, so it was possible for them to block the entrance or end up surrounded.

To prevent this as much as possible, we have trained them to move freely.



These are the changes to the specifications of the Japanese DEMO version [2.1.0].



We will continue to make adjustments based on feedback and strive to improve
the quality of the final version.


Also, regarding the [freeze bug] that was previously announced,
we are compiling reports in the [Freeze?] thread of the [Journey of Reincarnation ]
community to find reproducibility.

If you experience freezing, 
please read this or let us know the situation so that we can improve the game.

Also, the game may be compatible with background tasks,
so if you can close other tasks as much as possible while playing, 
this will help improve the game environment.
(This does not occur on the PC where the game is being tested.)


This has become a long message, but I am extremely grateful 
to those who have reviewed the game, played it, 
and shared the game through streaming videos.

I believe this response is to improve the quality of 
the final version and create an environment 
in which you can play the game in better conditions.


We hope you will continue to support us.


MSBgamedev : MASABOKURI

notes.title: Japanese DEMO version update [Version 2.0.5]
notes.content:
Around 11pm on August 4th, Japan time
The Japanese trial version has been updated.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this additional correction.

A problem occurred due to a specification change made the day before yesterday, 
so we have applied a patch to fix it.

・A bug that caused the game to freeze when using the mouse to select a category on the menu skill screen.

・A bug that caused the skill "Ukenagashi" to behave incorrectly.

・A bug that made it difficult to pick up attack magic skills from the in-dungeon store.


We have also reviewed and fixed the balance of character thinking.


MSBgamedev：MASABOKURI

notes.title: Japanese Trial Version Update August 3 [Version 2.0.2+]
notes.content:
Around 8pm on August 3rd, Japan time
The MP recovery specifications for the Japanese trial version have been changed.
This was an additional step added to yesterday's version update,
so the version remains the same, at [2.0.2].


-The specifications of the skill "TP Convert" have been changed.


Previously, this skill only worked in the rear guard position, 
but with this latest update, it can now also be used in the front line, 
and can also be used at any time on the map from the [Skills] menu in the main menu.

The skill cost remains the same, but it converts 50 TP into 50% MP.

Along with this, "TP conversion" has been removed from the in-dungeon store.

We've also added an explanation about MP recovery to the tutorial.
However, this is just one page that is urgently needed,
and we plan to update the finer details, such as the explanation of TP,
when we update the entire tutorial, so please wait a little longer.

We will continue to carefully review feedback, make balance adjustments, 
and strive to improve the quality of the final version.


MSBgamedev：MASABOKURI

notes.title: Japanese Trial Version Update August 2 [Version 2.0.2]
notes.content:
At around 10pm on August 2nd, Japan time, 
the Japanese trial version was updated to [Version 2.0.2].

If you have downloaded it before, please update it from the store.


- Fixed a bug that unintentionally applied -1 attack power to "Silence I."

- When entering a dungeon for the first time, an announcement is 
  made that states that you cannot exit the dungeon until 
  you are wiped out or your mission is completed.
 Added an announcement that allows you to carry over "Soul gem"

- Slightly reduced the durability of enemies in the early stages to speed up the tempo of early battles.


Also, as previously announced,
the tutorial will be updated as soon as the English version of the DEMO is completed in mid-August.
In this tutorial update, we are working to make the text more concise and to add additional information about TP and other things that have not been announced.

Sorry for the delay.


We would also like to express our deepest gratitude to those who played the DEMO version, 
left reviews, and provided feedback.


Since releasing the DEMO version in June, 
we have been able to significantly improve the game content.


We are working hard to complete the final version by the end of the year, 
so we would appreciate your continued support.


MSBgamedev：MASABOKURI

notes.title: Trial version update June 25th [Version 1.1.3]
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033061/dd4b9241b448d4f4630cddb21e6c83ed3349e05e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033061/6812159e566f931f9c052d8c0bde192312f767c8.png[/img][/url]


The Japanese trial version was updated around noon on June 25th, Japan time.
If you downloaded it before this, please update it from the store page.


・A map has been added where you can purchase [Forbidden Fruit] from the entrance.
　We won't say much about this item here.
　Please check it out for yourself as you play and decide whether to use it or not.
(There are no irreversible elements or hints at future plot developments, so feel free to pick it up.)

・The character parameters window during battle was designed with a frame removed for visibility, 
    but to ensure uniformity, we added a frame like other windows.

・Other changes included adjustments to battle balance and improvements to character thinking.


With this update, we will put an end to the trial patch and shift development 
to localizing the English version of DEMO.

However, the tutorial visuals need some revision, 
so we are brushing them up in parallel with the production of the English DEMO, 
and will update them once everything is renewed.


Thank you for your understanding.


MSBgamedev：MASABOKURI

notes.title: Trial version update June 20th [Version 1.1.1]
notes.content:
The trial version was updated around 5:00 PM on June 20th, Japan time.
If you downloaded it before this date,
we apologize for the inconvenience, but please update it from the store page.


・We have fixed a bug where the skill "Revive I" was not activating properly.

・The pattern table of characters that can be made into companions in the dungeon was biased. 
　The pattern table has been reviewed and corrected
　so that players can travel with as diverse a group as possible.

・Placed character images on the equipment menu screen to make it easier to see which character's equipment is currently being changed.

・Changed some skill animations to make them easier to distinguish from other skills.

・The skill "Ikkatsu" has been changed from
　 [increase the defense of the entire PT] to [increase the user's own defense], 
　because at the time of the trial version, 
　PT actions tended to be passive and battles tended to drag on indefinitely.

・The previous update to lighten the combat process has been replaced with a specification that speeds up recovery when the game becomes slow, not only in combat, but throughout the game.

・Other typos and other errors have been corrected.


The English version of the DEMO will be finished in June, 
and the translation work will begin in July. 
Please wait a little longer if you would like to enjoy it in English. We will do our best.


MSBgamedev：MASABOKURI

notes.title: Trial version update June 17th [Version 1.1.0]
notes.content:
The trial version was updated around 8:00 PM on June 17th, Japan time.
If you downloaded it before this date,
we apologize for the inconvenience, but please update it from the store page.

・Due to the special status that is activated during the secret boss battle, 
   we have been forced to change the specifications 
   because we cannot eliminate the possibility of bugs being caused.
   This change has been made with the aim of not upsetting the battle balance as much as possible.
   Thank you for your understanding.

・It was possible to equip duplicate jewel, but this did not change the effect, 
　so we changed it so that duplicate jewel cannot be equipped to avoid any misunderstandings.

・There have been reports of freezing during battles on some PCs.
　We have made changes to the specifications to lighten processing during battles
　so that this can be avoided as much as possible. 
　If you are still experiencing the same issue, please report it in the thread, 
   as it may lead to an improvement.


Other minor UI tweaks have been made.

MSBgamedev : MASABOKURI

notes.title: Trial version update June 15th ”version 1.0.8”
notes.content:
The trial version was updated at around midnight on June 15th, Japan time.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you downloaded it before then,
please update it from the store page.


・Fixed an issue where if you were wiped out after defeating the gatekeepers on each floor,
　a staircase would appear on the first floor of the next dungeon
　even though the gatekeepers had not been defeated.


・Fixed an issue where Priests and Mages had "skills" that were not displayed correctly in the menu skills.

・When using the mouse on the menu screen or the status/equipment/skill screen, 
　you could not select a character unless you returned to the main menu. 
　Now, a click button is placed in the bottom right corner, 
　allowing you to select a character directly from each page.

・Other minor bugs have been fixed.


MSBgamedev：MASABOKURI

notes.title: Japanese version DEMO patch June 12th
notes.content:
We released the trial version yesterday, and there were some bugs in it that we have now fixed.

・Fixed an issue where "Rapid Strike" and "Three Rapid Strikes" 
　did not function properly when equipped by a Mage Priest.
　The skill in question has been replaced with a sword technique called "○○ Slash."

At the same time, we have also patched in some feedback.

・The battle speed-up button at the top left of the battle has been revised to make it easier to understand.

・At the start of the game, the formation has been fixed so that the partner starts as the rear guard.

・Additionally, Jonah's initial equipment will be changed to "Skill Stone: Quick Aid" when the game starts.

・Similarly, at the start of the game, Sophia's initial equipment has been changed to "Skill Stone: Quick Aid."

The above patches have been applied, so if you have already downloaded them, please update them from the store page.

MSBgamedev：MASABOKURI
